question: How does the teaching answer the objection that lower faculties cannot reach Shiva?
premises: In reality Shiva alone is the one reality.
Shiva can conceal his own nature.
Even while concealed, he remains self-luminous and can appear in that form.
inference: Therefore the lower faculties can appear to reach Shiva because it is Shiva himself who, while self-luminous, conceals and manifests his own nature in that way.
plain_english: The answer is that, in reality, it is Shiva alone. Being self-luminous, he conceals his own nature and then appears again in that very form.
